rules.title: incomplete native analysis
rules.message: The compiler frontend or structural fact build did not complete; Clippy cannot publish a successful analysis.
rules.fix: Correct the reported input or frontend failure and rerun the complete scan. No suppression, advisory mode, or textual fallback can make an incomplete analysis valid.

rules.title: blanket suppression
rules.message: Blanket clippy-grade suppressions hide quality debt across unrelated findings.
rules.fix: Suppress one rule id on one line and include a concrete reason.

rules.title: reasonless suppression
rules.message: A clippy-grade suppression without a reason is not reviewable.
rules.fix: Add reason=<why this exact finding is intentional> or remove the suppression.

rules.title: unknown suppression rule
rules.message: A suppression references a rule id that is not in the clippy-grade inventory.
rules.fix: Use a registered rule id from --list-rules or delete the stale suppression.

rules.title: pointless let binding
rules.message: An unannotated local is immediately returned through the same lexical binder, with no intervening expression.
rules.fix: Manual: replace the local let expression with its initializer after reviewing the surrounding type context. Preserve initializer evaluation and public declarations. This Clippy finding does not claim an exact expression span or a MachineApplicable edit.

rules.title: same branch expression
rules.message: Every distinct arm of a complete closed local enum match returns the same proven value; the scrutinee is a value and the arms contain no calls.
rules.fix: Manual: review the reported binder, literal, or constructor identity and use the common value where the surrounding type context permits. Retain public signatures and ownership boundaries. Imported/indexed matches and effectful expressions are not collapsed by this rule.

rules.title: raw fs read
rules.message: User-facing code bypasses checked filesystem reading.
rules.fix: Use fs_read_checked, fsx_read_text, or another typed FsError-returning wrapper.

rules.title: raw fs write
rules.message: User-facing code bypasses checked filesystem writing.
rules.fix: Use fs_write_checked, fsx_write_text, or a checked overwrite policy wrapper.

rules.title: raw process execution
rules.message: User-facing code invokes a process through an unchecked primitive.
rules.fix: Use process_run_checked/processx helpers so failures become typed ProcessError values.

rules.title: ignored checked result
rules.message: An executed, registered must-observe checked result has no observation or escape through any alias.
rules.fix: Review-required: handle or propagate the checked failure. Generic Either and an unexecuted IO action do not establish this diagnostic.

rules.title: success exit after error
rules.message: A known error branch exits or returns success status.
rules.fix: Return a nonzero exit status after printing or propagating the error.

rules.title: obvious Left success
rules.message: A failure arm of a registered must-observe checked result returns the resolved success constructor.
rules.fix: Review-required: preserve the checked failure, or route intentional recovery through an explicit policy API. Literal error codes and reports are not success constructors.

rules.title: token-identical declaration
rules.message: Two nontrivial declarations have identical tokens apart from their own names and trivia, retaining signatures, binders, callees and literal values.
rules.fix: Review the reported declaration and its earlier counterpart before extracting shared logic. Preserve public APIs and intentional ownership boundaries; this suggestion requires manual review, not automatic deletion.

rules.title: repeated pure conversion
rules.message: Repeated registered pure conversion, parse or normalization with identical value identities.
rules.fix: Review-required: reuse the result only after preserving evaluation order, scope and comments. No automatic edit is authorized.

rules.title: repeated pure traversal
rules.message: Repeated identical registered pure traversal, including callback and all argument identities.
rules.fix: Review-required: reuse the result only after preserving evaluation order, scope and comments. No automatic edit is authorized.

rules.title: self equality
rules.message: Registered reflexive Nat/String equality compares one semantic value with itself.
rules.fix: Review-required: use the proven boolean only while preserving evaluation, bindings and comments. No textual operator guessing or automatic edit.

rules.title: self strict ordering
rules.message: Registered strict Nat ordering compares one semantic value with itself.
rules.fix: Review-required: use the proven boolean only while preserving evaluation, bindings and comments. No textual operator guessing or automatic edit.

rules.title: neutral Nat arithmetic
rules.message: A resolved Nat arithmetic operation has a proven neutral operand and returns its other argument unchanged.
rules.fix: Review-required: Review the neutral operand, then use the unchanged value while preserving evaluation of every original argument. No machine-applicable edit is authorized.

rules.title: erasing Nat arithmetic
rules.message: Resolved Nat multiplication by zero, saturating subtraction from zero or itself, or remainder by one is proven to return zero.
rules.fix: Review-required: Review the operands for a mistake. Simplify only after retaining required evaluation; Nat subtraction is saturating. No machine-applicable edit is authorized.

rules.title: proven zero divisor
rules.message: A resolved Nat division or remainder API receives a literal zero divisor through its semantic value identity.
rules.fix: Review-required: Review or validate the divisor, or handle the intended zero case explicitly. Ouro div_nat returns zero and mod_nat returns the dividend for a zero divisor; this is not a panic diagnostic. No machine-applicable edit is authorized.

rules.title: constant Nat boundary ordering
rules.message: A resolved Nat comparison is constant because no Nat is less than zero, zero is at most every Nat, or a Nat is at most itself.
rules.fix: Review-required: Review the comparison and use the established result only while preserving operand evaluation. No machine-applicable edit is authorized.

rules.title: inverted literal interval bounds
rules.message: A resolved clamp_nat or between call has literal lower and upper bounds with lower greater than upper.
rules.fix: Review-required: Correct the interval or make the intended degenerate case explicit. Do not automatically swap bounds: doing so changes behavior. No machine-applicable edit is authorized.

rules.title: empty string concatenation
rules.message: A resolved binary string concatenation receives an explicitly present empty-string literal from the compiler intern pool.
rules.fix: Review-required: Use the unchanged string after reviewing evaluation. Missing intern entries are not evidence of an empty string. No machine-applicable edit is authorized.

rules.title: Boolean identity operation
rules.message: A resolved conjunction or disjunction is redundant by a registered Boolean identity or by identical known value identities.
rules.fix: Review-required: Use the unchanged Boolean after reviewing the condition and preserving original argument evaluation. No machine-applicable edit is authorized.

rules.title: absorbing Boolean operand
rules.message: A resolved conjunction with False or disjunction with True has a proven constant result.
rules.fix: Review-required: Review the absorbing operand as a possible logic error. Retain required argument evaluation when simplifying. No machine-applicable edit is authorized.

rules.title: zero list take or drop count
rules.message: A resolved list take or drop call receives a proven zero count.
rules.fix: Review-required: Review the count: take returns an empty list and drop returns the original list. Preserve evaluation of the input. No machine-applicable edit is authorized.

rules.title: double Boolean negation
rules.message: The same resolved Boolean negation consumes its own result in the same branch and effect epoch.
rules.fix: Review-required: Use the original Boolean after reviewing producer lineage and preserving evaluation. No machine-applicable edit is authorized.

rules.title: normalizing an already normalized result
rules.message: The same registered idempotent string normalization consumes its own result in one effect-free execution region. A registered traversal cost and nonconstant original input are required.
rules.fix: Review-required: Keep one normalization. Different normalizers, unknown wrappers and effect-separated operations do not establish this diagnostic. No machine-applicable edit is authorized.

rules.title: double list reversal
rules.message: The same resolved list reversal consumes its own result with identical element-type identity in one effect-free execution region. A registered traversal cost and nonconstant original input are required.
rules.fix: Review-required: Retain the original list and required evaluation. No automatic transformation or mixed-function equivalence is claimed. No machine-applicable edit is authorized.

rules.title: equal clamp bounds
rules.message: A resolved Nat clamp has identical lower and upper semantic values and always returns that bound.
rules.fix: Review-required: correct the interval or use the bound while preserving input evaluation. No machine-applicable edit is authorized.

rules.title: redundant Nat extremum operands
rules.message: A resolved Nat minimum or maximum has identical operands or a proven zero operand, making the result an existing operand or zero.
rules.fix: Review-required: use the established Nat extremum result after reviewing operand evaluation; this law does not apply to arbitrary comparators or floating point. No machine-applicable edit is authorized.

rules.title: trivial Nat exponentiation
rules.message: A resolved Nat power has exponent zero or one, or base one. In this API, zero to exponent zero is one.
rules.fix: Review-required: use one or the original base as established by the operands, retaining their evaluation. No machine-applicable edit is authorized.

rules.title: replacement cannot change text
rules.message: A resolved text replacement uses the same known semantic value for its needle and replacement.
rules.fix: Review-required: retain the original text and necessary argument evaluation instead of the unchanged replacement. No machine-applicable edit is authorized.

rules.title: empty string search predicate
rules.message: A resolved starts, ends or contains predicate receives an explicitly present empty-string needle and is always true.
rules.fix: Review-required: correct the needle or make the constant result explicit while retaining evaluation. Missing intern entries are not empty strings. No machine-applicable edit is authorized.

rules.title: literal byte index out of bounds
rules.message: A resolved string byte lookup has a literal index at or beyond its proven literal byte length and returns the out-of-range sentinel zero.
rules.fix: Review-required: correct or validate the byte index. Character counts and byte offsets are not interchangeable, and this API does not panic here. No machine-applicable edit is authorized.

rules.title: zero length string slice
rules.message: A resolved string slice receives a proven zero count and returns empty text.
rules.fix: Review-required: review the byte count and preserve source and offset evaluation before using empty text. No machine-applicable edit is authorized.

rules.title: literal slice starts past text
rules.message: A resolved string slice starts at or beyond its proven literal byte length with a positive literal count and returns empty text.
rules.fix: Review-required: correct the start or count; the final argument is a count rather than an end position. Preserve evaluation. No machine-applicable edit is authorized.

rules.title: string searches for itself
rules.message: A resolved starts, ends or contains predicate compares a string with the same known semantic value and is always true.
rules.fix: Review-required: review both operands and preserve their evaluation when making the constant result explicit. No machine-applicable edit is authorized.

rules.title: Result test has known constructor
rules.message: A resolved Result constructor test consumes a known Left or Right producer in the same branch and effect epoch with matching error and payload type identities.
rules.fix: Review-required: use the constructor-established predicate result while preserving producer evaluation; unknown or checked results without this constructor proof remain untouched. No machine-applicable edit is authorized.

rules.title: Result default cannot be selected
rules.message: A resolved Result default consumes a known Right producer with matching type identities in one effect-free execution region.
rules.fix: Review-required: use the successful payload only while preserving eager fallback evaluation and any other producer uses. Do not erase handling of unknown failures. No machine-applicable edit is authorized.

rules.title: absorbed nested Nat extremum
rules.message: Opposite resolved Nat extrema share the outer operand through known value identities, establishing min x (max x y) or max x (min x y).
rules.fix: Review-required: retain the outer operand after reviewing every original evaluation and producer use. No machine-applicable edit is authorized.

rules.title: Maybe default cannot be selected
rules.message: A resolved Maybe default consumes a known Just producer of the same payload type in one effect-free execution region.
rules.fix: Review-required: use the payload only while preserving eager fallback evaluation. Generic Maybe values and Nothing do not establish an unused fallback. No machine-applicable edit is authorized.

rules.title: length allocates a reversed list
rules.message: A resolved list length consumes a nonconstant list reversal with matching element-type identity and registered traversal costs in one effect-free region.
rules.fix: Review-required: measure the original list rather than allocating its reversal. Check other uses and retain required evaluation. No machine-applicable edit is authorized.

rules.title: length allocates an appended list
rules.message: A resolved list length consumes a fresh list append with matching element-type identity, nonconstant input and registered traversal costs in one effect-free region.
rules.fix: Review-required: add the two input lengths without constructing the appended list, after reviewing evaluation order and other producer uses. No machine-applicable edit is authorized.

rules.title: outer take cannot shorten its input
rules.message: A resolved outer list take has a positive literal count at least as large as the positive literal count of its producer take, with matching type and execution region.
rules.fix: Review-required: retain the inner take result and avoid the redundant traversal while preserving evaluation. Unknown counts do not establish dominance. No machine-applicable edit is authorized.

rules.title: drop exhausts a bounded take
rules.message: A resolved list drop has a positive literal count at least as large as its producer take's positive bound and therefore returns an empty list.
rules.fix: Review-required: correct the counts or make the empty result explicit without deleting input evaluation. No machine-applicable edit is authorized.

rules.title: outer clamp cannot change its input
rules.message: An outer resolved clamp interval contains the producer clamp's entire ordered literal interval in one effect-free execution region.
rules.fix: Review-required: retain the inner clamp after checking evaluation and other uses. Overlapping, inverted or unknown intervals do not establish containment. No machine-applicable edit is authorized.

rules.title: range test is fixed after clamping
rules.message: A resolved range predicate either contains or is disjoint from its producer clamp's ordered literal interval, making its result constant.
rules.fix: Review-required: review the interval test and preserve evaluation when using the established Boolean result. Partially overlapping or unknown bounds remain unreported. No machine-applicable edit is authorized.

rules.title: Boolean operation combines complements
rules.message: A resolved conjunction or disjunction combines a Boolean value with its resolved negation through producer lineage in the same branch and effect epoch.
rules.fix: Review-required: review the condition; conjunction is false and disjunction is true. Preserve original argument evaluation. No machine-applicable edit is authorized.

rules.title: success map cannot run on failure
rules.message: A resolved Result success map consumes a proven Left producer with matching input types in the same branch and effect epoch; its callback cannot run.
rules.fix: Review-required: propagate the error at the output payload type. Preserve producer and callback-expression evaluation. This is not permission to discard a checked failure or an automatic edit.

rules.title: error map cannot run on success
rules.message: A resolved result_map_err or mapLeft consumes a proven Right producer with matching input types; its error callback cannot run.
rules.fix: Review-required: retain the success payload at the output error type, preserving evaluation. The distinct type-argument orders of the two APIs must not be interchanged. No automatic edit is authorized.

rules.title: Result continuation cannot run on failure
rules.message: A resolved Result bind or and_then consumes a proven Left producer; its continuation cannot run and the original error is propagated.
rules.fix: Review-required: retain the error at the output payload type and preserve all argument evaluation. Do not replace error propagation with success. No automatic edit is authorized.

rules.title: Result recovery cannot run on success
rules.message: A resolved Result or_else consumes a proven Right producer and cannot invoke its recovery callback.
rules.fix: Review-required: retain the successful result after preserving recovery-expression evaluation. Unknown failures still require their recovery policy. No automatic edit is authorized.

rules.title: Result fold has a fixed handler
rules.message: A resolved Either or Result fold consumes a proven Left or Right producer; exactly one handler is selected, with callback effects accounted for.
rules.fix: Review-required: invoke the selected handler on the payload while preserving evaluation of both handler expressions and the producer. No automatic edit is authorized.

rules.title: Maybe map cannot run on Nothing
rules.message: A resolved Maybe map consumes a proven Nothing producer and cannot invoke its callback.
rules.fix: Review-required: use Nothing at the output payload type, preserving producer and callback-expression evaluation. No automatic edit is authorized.

rules.title: Maybe fold has a fixed selection
rules.message: A resolved Maybe fold consumes a proven Just or Nothing producer and has a fixed callback or default selection.
rules.fix: Review-required: retain the selected handler invocation or default. Preserve eager default evaluation even when Just selects the handler. No automatic edit is authorized.

rules.title: Result to Maybe has a known constructor
rules.message: A resolved Result-to-Maybe conversion consumes a proven Left or Right producer; the corresponding Nothing or Just selection is fixed.
rules.fix: Review-required: construct the established Maybe value only after preserving payload evaluation. This explicit conversion policy is not diagnosed as accidental error loss. No automatic edit is authorized.

rules.title: Maybe to Result has a known constructor
rules.message: A resolved Maybe-to-Result conversion consumes a proven Just or Nothing producer; its success or error selection is fixed.
rules.fix: Review-required: construct the established Result value while preserving eager error-argument evaluation and all original effects. No automatic edit is authorized.

rules.title: Result default is always selected
rules.message: A resolved Result default consumes a proven Left producer and always selects its fallback.
rules.fix: Review-required: use the fallback only after preserving producer and payload evaluation. Explicit fallback policy is not silent error loss, and unknown results remain untouched. No automatic edit is authorized.

rules.title: Maybe default is always selected
rules.message: A resolved Maybe default consumes a proven Nothing producer and always selects its fallback.
rules.fix: Review-required: retain the fallback and all original evaluation. This law does not apply to an unknown Maybe or a Just payload. No automatic edit is authorized.

rules.title: Result map2 has a failing first input
rules.message: The first input of resolved left-biased Result map2 is a proven Left, so that error is propagated and its callback cannot run.
rules.fix: Review-required: propagate the first error while retaining evaluation of the second Result and callback expression. The second input is not lazy and must not be deleted blindly. No automatic edit is authorized.

rules.title: Result unit conversion only propagates failure
rules.message: A resolved Result-to-unit conversion consumes a proven Left producer and propagates its error with a Unit payload type.
rules.fix: Review-required: retain the original error at the Unit result type and preserve evaluation. Do not convert failure to success. No automatic edit is authorized.

rules.title: Result unit conversion is repeated
rules.message: A resolved Result-to-unit conversion consumes another such conversion with matching error and payload type identities in one effect-free region.
rules.fix: Review-required: keep the inner result and its evaluation. Detection is deliberately restricted to matching type identities; no type-name guessing or automatic edit is authorized.

rules.title: Maybe Result Maybe round trip
rules.message: A resolved Maybe-to-Result-to-Maybe chain restores the original Maybe with matching error and payload type identities.
rules.fix: Review-required: use the original Maybe only after preserving eager error-argument evaluation. The opposite Result-to-Maybe-to-Result round trip can lose errors and is not this law. No automatic edit is authorized.

rules.title: Result success map uses an identity callback
rules.message: A resolved Result success map uses a complete, owner-matched, pure unary return-argument summary with unchanged input and output types.
rules.fix: Review-required: retain the original result and evaluation. An identity map is aliasing, not observation; any original checked-result obligation remains. No automatic edit is authorized.

rules.title: Result error map uses an identity callback
rules.message: A resolved Result error map uses a complete, owner-matched, pure unary return-argument summary with unchanged error types.
rules.fix: Review-required: retain the original result without treating the identity callback as recovery or observation. Preserve any checked failure obligation and all evaluation. No automatic edit is authorized.

rules.title: Maybe map uses an identity callback
rules.message: A resolved Maybe map uses a complete, owner-matched, pure unary return-argument summary with unchanged payload types.
rules.fix: Review-required: retain the original Maybe and its evaluation. Unknown, partial, effectful or semantics-changing callbacks do not establish identity. No automatic edit is authorized.

rules.title: checked Result is tested again on its selected arm
rules.message: A resolved Result predicate inspects the same executed checked producer whose Left or Right arm is already selected, with a unique match witness and unchanged branch and effect epoch.
rules.fix: Review-required: use the arm-established predicate result while preserving evaluation. Generic Either, another producer, effects, sibling branches and deferred actions do not establish this proof. No automatic edit is authorized.

rules.title: checked Result fallback is unreachable on its success arm
rules.message: A resolved Result default consumes the same executed checked producer on its selected Right arm in the same effect epoch; its fallback cannot be selected.
rules.fix: Review-required: retain the selected success payload while preserving eager fallback evaluation. Failure arms and ambiguous control flow remain untouched. No automatic edit is authorized.

rules.title: length materializes a mapped list
rules.message: Resolved list length consumes an unbound map over a dynamic source with a known total callback and compatible element types.
rules.fix: Review-required: measure the original list without mapping. Preserve source evaluation and ownership. No automatic edit is authorized.

rules.title: length materializes a filtered list
rules.message: Resolved list length consumes an unbound filter with a known total predicate over a dynamic source in the same execution region.
rules.fix: Review-required: use count_if with the same predicate and source instead of allocating survivors solely to count them. No automatic edit is authorized.

rules.title: composable maps materialize an intermediate
rules.message: Two resolved total maps have a proven producer edge and compatible intermediate element-type identity, with an unbound dynamic producer.
rules.fix: Review-required: compose the callbacks in one map, preserving their inner-then-outer order for each element. Do not duplicate either callback. No automatic edit is authorized.

rules.title: length materializes a bounded prefix
rules.message: Resolved length consumes an unbound positive take over a dynamic list with the same element-type identity.
rules.fix: Review-required: use a count-bounded length scan that stops at the take bound. Do not replace it with a full-list length, which can do more work. No automatic edit is authorized.

rules.title: map materializes a filter intermediate
rules.message: A resolved total map consumes an unbound filter with a proven total predicate and compatible element types.
rules.fix: Review-required: fuse selection and mapping in one traversal, calling the mapper only for selected elements. Preserve callback order within each element. No automatic edit is authorized.

rules.title: filter materializes a map intermediate
rules.message: A resolved total filter consumes an unbound total map with compatible intermediate element-type identity.
rules.fix: Review-required: fuse the traversal, bind each mapped value once, test that value, and retain it only when selected. Never call the mapper twice. No automatic edit is authorized.

rules.title: mapping before taking a prefix
rules.message: A positive resolved take consumes an unbound total map over a dynamic source in the same execution region.
rules.fix: Review-required: take the prefix before mapping so discarded suffix elements need not be mapped. Preserve type arguments and source evaluation. No automatic edit is authorized.

rules.title: mapping before dropping a prefix
rules.message: A positive resolved drop consumes an unbound total map over a dynamic source with compatible element types.
rules.fix: Review-required: drop the prefix before mapping so discarded prefix elements are not mapped or copied. Preserve source evaluation. No automatic edit is authorized.

rules.title: take copies an unnecessarily large prefix
rules.message: A positive resolved take consumes an unbound take with a strictly larger proven positive count over a dynamic list.
rules.fix: Review-required: take the smaller outer count directly from the original list. Unknown, zero, equal or larger outer counts do not establish this rule. No automatic edit is authorized.

rules.title: drop discards a freshly copied prefix
rules.message: A resolved drop has a positive proven count strictly below its unbound producer take's positive count.
rules.fix: Review-required: take the remaining count after dropping the original prefix, preserving source evaluation and element type. Exhausting or unknown counts are excluded. No automatic edit is authorized.

rules.title: reverse materializes an appended list
rules.message: Resolved list reversal consumes an unbound append with a dynamic left input and compatible element types in the same execution region.
rules.fix: Review-required: replace reverse (append xs ys) with rev_append ys (reverse xs), not the opposite order. Preserve input evaluation and sharing. No automatic edit is authorized.

rules.title: left-associated list append copies twice
rules.message: A resolved list append copies an unbound append as its left operand, with a dynamic original left input and compatible element types.
rules.fix: Review-required: associate append to the right: append xs (append ys zs). An append only in the right operand does not establish this rule. No automatic edit is authorized.

rules.title: map materializes a reversed intermediate
rules.message: A resolved total map consumes an unbound list reversal over a dynamic source with compatible element types.
rules.fix: Review-required: map and prepend during one forward accumulator traversal. Preserve the final reversed order; callback reordering requires the established total contract. No automatic edit is authorized.

rules.title: filter materializes a reversed intermediate
rules.message: A resolved total filter consumes an unbound list reversal over a dynamic source with compatible element types.
rules.fix: Review-required: select and prepend during one forward accumulator traversal, retaining reversed survivor order. Unknown predicates remain untouched. No automatic edit is authorized.

rules.title: reverse materializes a mapped intermediate
rules.message: Resolved reversal consumes an unbound total map over a dynamic source with compatible intermediate element-type identity.
rules.fix: Review-required: map and prepend in one accumulator traversal rather than allocating the mapped list before reversal. Preserve final order and source evaluation. No automatic edit is authorized.

rules.title: reverse materializes a filtered intermediate
rules.message: Resolved reversal consumes an unbound total filter over a dynamic source with compatible element-type identity.
rules.fix: Review-required: select and prepend in one accumulator traversal instead of copying the survivors again during reversal. Preserve final order. No automatic edit is authorized.

rules.title: filter repeats the same total predicate
rules.message: A resolved filter consumes its own result using the same known total predicate and element type in one execution region.
rules.fix: Review-required: retain the first filter and its other uses; do not test and copy its survivors again. This does not assume arbitrary predicates terminate. No automatic edit is authorized.

rules.title: full trim absorbs a temporary side trim
rules.message: The canonical full string trim consumes an unbound left or right trim of a dynamic source in one execution region.
rules.fix: Review-required: trim the original string once. Both boundary trims are already included in full trim. Unknown or changing wrappers do not establish absorption. No automatic edit is authorized.

rules.title: side trim follows a full trim
rules.message: A canonical left or right string trim consumes a fully trimmed dynamic producer in the same execution region.
rules.fix: Review-required: reuse the fully trimmed result, retaining its other consumers. The extra boundary normalization cannot change it. No automatic edit is authorized.

rules.title: ASCII case normalization absorbs its opposite
rules.message: Canonical ASCII upper/lower normalization consumes an unbound opposite case normalization of a dynamic source in one execution region.
rules.fix: Review-required: apply only the outer ASCII case normalization to the original source. No Unicode case-folding, locale or arbitrary conversion equivalence is inferred. No automatic edit is authorized.

rules.title: emptiness query allocates a reversal
rules.message: List reversal preserves emptiness, but its unbound result is used only by a resolved emptiness query.
rules.fix: Review-required: query the original list without constructing its reversal. Preserve argument evaluation and ownership. No machine-applicable edit is authorized.

rules.title: endpoint query allocates a reversal
rules.message: A resolved head or last consumes an unbound reversal; reversing exchanges the endpoints, including the empty-list default.
rules.fix: Review-required: use last for head of reverse, or head for last of reverse, retaining the same default and original evaluation. No machine-applicable edit is authorized.

rules.title: emptiness query allocates an append
rules.message: An unbound list append with a nonconstant left input is constructed only to test emptiness.
rules.fix: Review-required: combine the emptiness of both inputs rather than constructing the append, preserving evaluation of both inputs. No machine-applicable edit is authorized.

rules.title: length materializes a replicated list
rules.message: The length of an unbound replicated list is exactly its replication count.
rules.fix: Review-required: use the replication count, retaining required evaluation of the payload. No machine-applicable edit is authorized.

rules.title: emptiness materializes a replicated list
rules.message: The emptiness of an unbound replicated list depends only on whether its count is zero.
rules.fix: Review-required: test the replication count against zero instead of materializing the list, retaining required argument evaluation. No machine-applicable edit is authorized.

rules.title: endpoint materializes a replicated list
rules.message: A replicated list has the payload at both endpoints when its count is positive, and selects the supplied default when the count is zero.
rules.fix: Review-required: select the default for count zero and the payload otherwise, without building the replicated list. Preserve eager default and payload evaluation. No machine-applicable edit is authorized.

rules.title: reversing a replicated list
rules.message: All elements of the resolved replicate producer are equal, so its reversal cannot change the list.
rules.fix: Review-required: retain the replicated list without reversing it, preserving original argument evaluation. No machine-applicable edit is authorized.

rules.title: counted selection materializes excess replication
rules.message: A resolved take or drop consumes an unbound replicate and can be expressed by adjusting the replication count.
rules.fix: Review-required: for take, replicate the minimum of both counts; for drop, replicate the saturating difference of replication count and drop count. Preserve original evaluation. No machine-applicable edit is authorized.

rules.title: index lookup materializes a replicated list
rules.message: A resolved indexed lookup of an unbound replicate depends only on whether the index is below the replication count.
rules.fix: Review-required: select the payload when the index is below the count and the original default otherwise. Preserve eager argument evaluation. No machine-applicable edit is authorized.

rules.title: length materializes separators
rules.message: For an input of length n, the resolved intersperse result has length saturating-subtract(2*n, 1).
rules.fix: Review-required: measure the original list once and compute its interspersed length without constructing separators. Retain separator and input evaluation. No machine-applicable edit is authorized.

rules.title: emptiness query materializes separators
rules.message: The resolved intersperse operation preserves emptiness.
rules.fix: Review-required: query the original list without constructing the interspersed list, retaining separator and input evaluation. No machine-applicable edit is authorized.

rules.title: endpoint query materializes separators
rules.message: The resolved intersperse operation preserves both endpoints and the empty-list default.
rules.fix: Review-required: query the same endpoint of the original list with the same default, preserving eager argument evaluation. No machine-applicable edit is authorized.

rules.title: emptiness query copies a positive prefix
rules.message: A resolved take with a proven positive literal count preserves the input emptiness.
rules.fix: Review-required: test the original list for emptiness without copying its prefix, preserving original evaluation. Unknown counts do not prove this law. No machine-applicable edit is authorized.

rules.title: head query copies a positive prefix
rules.message: A resolved take with a proven positive literal count preserves the input head and its empty-list default.
rules.fix: Review-required: query the original head with the same default without copying a prefix, preserving eager evaluation. Unknown counts do not prove this law. No machine-applicable edit is authorized.

rules.title: inner take copies a discarded prefix suffix
rules.message: The outer take has a proven positive literal count strictly smaller than its unbound producer take.
rules.fix: Review-required: apply the smaller outer count directly to the original list; do not first copy the larger prefix. Retain required evaluation. No machine-applicable edit is authorized.

rules.title: nested positive list offsets
rules.message: Two resolved drops with positive literal counts compose to one offset equal to their sum. No allocation or asymptotic improvement is claimed.
rules.fix: Review-required: express the composed offset with one drop, preserving the original input evaluation. No machine-applicable edit is authorized.

rules.title: querying a known singleton size
rules.message: A resolved singleton producer has length one and is nonempty independently of its payload.
rules.fix: Review-required: use one for length or False for emptiness, retaining the payload evaluation. No machine-applicable edit is authorized.

rules.title: projecting a known singleton endpoint
rules.message: A resolved head, last, or zero-index lookup consumes a known singleton producer.
rules.fix: Review-required: use the singleton payload, retaining eager evaluation of the supplied default. Nonzero or unknown indices do not establish this rule. No machine-applicable edit is authorized.

rules.title: taking the tail of a known singleton
rules.message: A resolved singleton producer has an empty tail.
rules.fix: Review-required: use an empty list of the same element type while retaining payload evaluation. No machine-applicable edit is authorized.

rules.title: reversing a known singleton
rules.message: Reversal cannot change a resolved singleton producer.
rules.fix: Review-required: retain the singleton without reversing it, preserving original payload evaluation. No machine-applicable edit is authorized.
